query: MATCH (a:Neuron)-[e:ConnectsTo]->(b:Neuron) WHERE b.bodyId IN [10001,10010] AND e.weight >= 100 RETURN toString(a.bodyId) AS pre, a.type AS preType, a.instance AS preInstance, a.consensusNt AS preNt, toString(b.bodyId) AS post, b.type AS postType, e.weight AS weight ORDER BY weight DESC LIMIT 257
